title: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
summary: Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models is constrained by scarce action-labeled demonstrations and incompatible control spaces across robot embodiments. We present RynnVLA-Latent, a framework that turns heterogeneous interaction videos into scalable supervision for robot policy pretraining. At its core, RynnLAM learns continuous, 3D-grounded latent actions from visual transitions without requiring native robot controls. By combining residual future-feature prediction, camera-compensated 3D-flow supervision, and camera-motion decoupling, RynnLAM encourages representations that capture control-relevant motion rather than appearance changes alone. We apply RynnLAM to 30.1K hours of human, robot, and simulation videos, producing 745.52M latent-action descriptors. RynnVLA-Latent then learns to predict latent-action chunks from visual observations and language through flow matching, before adapting its pretrained backbone and action expert to embodiment-specific robot actions. The resulting 4B policy achieves 98.8% success on LIBERO, 84.7% on LIBERO-Plus without benchmark-specific adaptation, 51.9% average success across five VLABench tracks, and 88.6% average success on the RoboTwin 2.0 bimanual benchmark. It also achieves the highest observed success rates among the compared methods on six real-world manipulation tasks across dexterous-hand and mobile-gripper platforms. Together with representation ablations and data-scaling results, these findings demonstrate the potential of latent-action supervision for scaling robot policy learning beyond native action-labeled data.
tldr: RynnVLA-Latent scales robotic manipulation foundation models by learning 3D-grounded latent actions from heterogeneous videos, achieving state-of-the-art results across simulation and real-world manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RynnVLA-Latent通过从异构视频中学习3D基础潜在动作来扩展机器人操作基础模型，在仿真和真实世界操作基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 扩展视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型受限于稀缺的动作标注演示数据以及不同机器人本体之间不兼容的控制空间。我们提出RynnVLA-Latent框架，将异构交互视频转化为机器人策略预训练的可扩展监督信号。其核心组件RynnLAM从视觉转换中学习连续的、基于三维空间的潜在动作，无需依赖原生机器人控制信号。通过融合残差未来特征预测、相机补偿三维光流监督以及相机运动解耦，RynnLAM鼓励表征捕获与控制相关的运动信息，而非仅关注外观变化。我们将RynnLAM应用于30.1K小时的人类、机器人和仿真视频数据，生成745.52M个潜在动作描述符。随后，RynnVLA-Latent通过流匹配学习从视觉观察和语言中预测潜在动作片段，再将其预训练骨干网络和动作专家模块适配到具体本体的机器人动作上。该4B参数策略在LIBERO基准上达到98.8%的成功率，在无需基准特定适配的LIBERO-Plus上达到84.7%，在VLABench五个任务轨道上平均成功率为51.9%，在RoboTwin 2.0双臂基准上平均成功率为88.6%。此外，在涵盖灵巧手和移动夹爪平台的六项真实世界操作任务中，该方法在所有对比方法中取得了最高的成功率。结合表征消融实验和数据扩展结果，这些发现展示了潜在动作监督在超越原生动作标注数据、扩展机器人策略学习方面的巨大潜力。

title: RoboDuo: Attempt, Check and Atomic Recovery through Code for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map a language instruction and the current observation directly to actions, without checking whether the instruction has been completed. For long-horizon tasks, a single failed step therefore goes unnoticed and leaves the whole task unfinished. Such failed episodes, however, often end with the task partially complete. Moreover, the unfinished steps are reusable atomic skills that recur across demonstrations. A failed attempt can thus be recovered by composing with atomic skills. We propose RoboDuo, a closed-loop dual-system framework that uses code as the interface between a coding agent and two VLAs. The agent writes a program that lets a full-task VLA attempt the whole task and checks whether it is complete; on failure, an atomic VLA finishes the remaining steps. Since the agent emits no actions and only decides which VLA for execution, RoboDuo wraps an existing full-task VLA without updating its weights. To train the atomic VLA and the coding agent with the completion-checking ability, we build LIBERO-Atomic, LIBERO-Code, and LIBERO-Judge from a single set of LIBERO demonstrations. RoboDuo consistently improves X-VLA and $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks, and recovers failed rollouts of a frozen full-task VLA on a real robot.
tldr: RoboDuo is a closed-loop framework combining a coding agent with two VLAs to check task completion and recover from failures using atomic skills, improving VLA performance on long-horizon tasks without weight updates.
tldr_zh: RoboDuo 是一个闭环框架，结合编码代理和两个 VLA 来检查任务完成情况并利用原子技能从失败中恢复，在不更新权重的情况下提升 VLA 在长时程任务上的表现。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型直接将语言指令与当前观测映射为动作，而不检查指令是否已完成。对于长时程任务，单步失败因此不会被察觉，导致整个任务无法完成。然而，此类失败片段往往以任务部分完成而告终。此外，未完成的步骤是可复用的原子技能，这些技能在演示中反复出现。因此，一次失败的尝试可以通过与原子技能的组合来实现恢复。我们提出RoboDuo，一种闭环双系统框架，以代码作为编程智能体与两个VLA之间的接口。该智能体编写程序，让全任务VLA尝试完成整个任务并检查其是否完成；若失败，则由原子VLA完成剩余步骤。由于智能体不产生动作，仅决定执行哪个VLA，RoboDuo在不更新权重的前提下封装现有的全任务VLA。为训练具备完成检查能力的原子VLA和编程智能体，我们从同一组LIBERO演示中构建了LIBERO-Atomic、LIBERO-Code和LIBERO-Judge。RoboDuo在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO上持续提升X-VLA和$π_{0.5}$的性能，在长时程任务上提升最为显著，并在真实机器人上成功恢复冻结的全任务VLA失败回放。

title: IntNet: A Communication-Driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cooperative Autonomous Driving
summary: Achieving safety in autonomous driving through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a critical yet challenging task due to non-stationarity, partial observability, and the need for effective coordination among agents. Although earlier cooperative MARL methods have aimed to improve coordination by sharing encoded state observations, we find these strategies are insufficient in safety-critical scenarios. To address this gap, we present IntNet, a novel MARL framework that enhances safety by incorporating the transmission of vehicle intent and adaptive communication scheduling into a unified end-to-end learning paradigm, jointly optimising all components for safe coordination. Central to our approach is an observation prediction module that enables agents to forecast subsequent policy outputs, which they can then share across a vehicle-to-vehicle network. Our model-free architecture employs a Graph Attention Network to process incoming messages and a scheduler component to dynamically optimise the communication graph for bandwidth efficiency. We compare IntNet against state-of-the-art communicative MARL methods in complex urban environments with both autonomous and human-operated vehicles, achieving improved coordination, lower collision rates, and reducing communication efforts by up to 60\%. Through extensive experiments, we assess the framework's learning efficiency, scalability, and the balance between information sharing and bandwidth usage for collision-free trajectories.
tldr: IntNet is a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for cooperative autonomous driving that shares predicted intents and adaptively schedules communication, improving safety and reducing bandwidth usage.
tldr_zh: IntNet 是一个用于协作式自动驾驶的多智能体强化学习框架，通过共享预测意图和自适应通信调度来提升安全性并降低带宽消耗。
summary_zh: 通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）实现自动驾驶安全性是一项关键但具有挑战性的任务，原因在于环境的非平稳性、部分可观测性以及智能体之间有效协调的需求。尽管早期的合作式MARL方法旨在通过共享编码后的状态观测来提升协调性，但我们发现这些策略在安全关键场景中仍显不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了IntNet，一种新颖的MARL框架，通过将车辆意图传输与自适应通信调度融入统一端到端学习范式，联合优化所有组件以实现安全协调，从而提升安全性。该方法的核心是一个观测预测模块，使智能体能够预测后续策略输出，并通过车对车网络进行共享。我们无模型架构采用图注意力网络处理传入消息，并借助调度组件动态优化通信图以提高带宽效率。我们将IntNet与最先进的通信式MARL方法在包含自动驾驶车辆与人工驾驶车辆的复杂城市环境中进行比较，结果表明其实现了更优的协调、更低的碰撞率，并将通信开销降低了多达60%。通过大量实验，我们评估了该框架的学习效率、可扩展性以及信息共享与带宽使用之间的平衡，以实现无碰撞轨迹。

title: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation via Action Representation Pretraining
summary: Large-scale vision, language, and video pretraining has substantially improved the perception and generalization capabilities of robotic manipulation models, but action generation for complex dexterous manipulation remains constrained by the scarcity of robot demonstrations. Limited robot demonstrations must be used to learn both action representations and task-conditioned action distributions, making it difficult to adequately learn action representations and, in turn, limiting the ability of downstream generative models to generate complex dexterous actions. To address this limitation, we propose ARPG (Action Representation Pretraining and Generation), which explicitly separates action representation learning from action generation: we first pretrain an action representation encoder on large-scale human manipulation data. We then freeze the encoder and train a compact generative backbone (130M parameters) to learn task-conditioned action distributions in the encoder's representation space. Experimental results show that ARPG achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DexJoCo benchmark and improves the average success rate on bimanual dexterous manipulation from 10.1% for $π_{0.5}$ to 44.7%. Scaling experiments further show that broader coverage of human manipulation behaviors effectively improves downstream performance. These results indicate that action representation pretraining provides an independent scaling dimension for improving complex dexterous manipulation capabilities.
tldr: This paper introduces ARPG, which pretrains an action representation encoder on large-scale human manipulation data and freezes it while training a compact generative model for action generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on bimanual dexterous manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ARPG，在大规模人类操作数据上预训练动作表示编码器并冻结，同时训练紧凑的生成模型进行动作生成，在双手灵巧操作基准上取得了最优性能。
summary_zh: 大规模视觉、语言和视频预训练显著提升了机器人操作模型的感知与泛化能力，但复杂灵巧操作中的动作生成仍受限于机器人示范数据的稀缺。有限的动作示范必须同时用于学习动作表征和任务条件下的动作分布，这使得动作表征难以充分学习，进而限制了下游生成模型生成复杂灵巧动作的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出了ARPG（动作表征预训练与生成），其核心思想是将动作表征学习与动作生成明确分离：首先在大规模人类操作数据上预训练一个动作表征编码器，然后冻结该编码器，并训练一个紧凑的生成骨干网络（1.3亿参数），在编码器的表征空间中学习任务条件下的动作分布。实验结果表明，ARPG在DexJoCo基准上取得了最先进的性能，并将双臂灵巧操作的平均成功率从$π_{0.5}$的10.1%提升至44.7%。尺度实验进一步表明，更广泛的人类操作行为覆盖能有效提升下游任务的性能。这些结果表明，动作表征预训练为提升复杂灵巧操作能力提供了一个独立的扩展维度。

title: ThinkLocoManip: A Whole-Body Control Agentic Harness for Legged Loco-Manipulation
summary: In this paper, we propose ThinkLocoManip, an agentic harness for legged loco-manipulation designed to tackle complex, long-horizon tasks in large-scale environments. Existing approaches typically follow either direct action generation or a plan-then-act paradigm, both of which can struggle with the generalization and error-recovery capabilities required for extended task execution. In contrast, ThinkLocoManip adopts an interleaved reasoning-and-acting paradigm, allowing the agent to continuously reason about its current state, execute actions, observe their outcomes, and adapt its strategy accordingly. Building on this paradigm, our agentic harness orchestrates a suite of specialized tools for perception, navigation, manipulation, and locomotion, enabling flexible composition of heterogeneous capabilities. Unlike existing robotic agentic harnesses, ThinkLocoManip explicitly incorporates locomotion as a tool domain for agent reasoning and execution. We further design a set of skills that explicitly account for both tool usage within each functional domain and coordination across domains, supporting effective execution of complex behaviors over long horizons. To tackle task failure during long-horizon interactions, we develop keyframe thinking mechanism to preserve critical execution context and support efficient error recovery. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that ThinkLocoManip substantially outperforms representative methods based on both direct action generation and plan-then-act paradigms across challenging long-horizon legged loco-manipulation tasks. Notably, ThinkLocoManip achieves a success rate of 77%, more than twice that of the strongest plan-then-act baseline (37.1%). Our experiments further validate the effectiveness of interleaved reasoning and acting, tool orchestration, and coordinated skill execution.
tldr: ThinkLocoManip presents an agentic harness for legged loco-manipulation that interleaves reasoning and acting, integrating perception, navigation, manipulation, and locomotion tools, achieving a 77% success rate in long-horizon real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: ThinkLocoManip 提出了一种用于腿式全身操控的智能体框架，通过推理与执行交替进行，集成感知、导航、操作和运动工具，在长时间真实任务中取得了77%的成功率。
summary_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了ThinkLocoManip，一种用于腿式移动操作任务的智能体框架，旨在解决大规模环境中的复杂长时程任务。现有方法通常遵循直接动作生成或“先规划后执行”的范式，这两者都可能在长时间任务执行中面临泛化能力和错误恢复能力的不足。相比之下，ThinkLocoManip采用了一种交错推理与执行（interleaved reasoning-and-acting）范式，使智能体能够持续推理当前状态、执行动作、观察结果，并相应调整其策略。基于该范式，我们的智能体框架整合了一系列专用工具，涵盖感知、导航、操作和移动，支持异构能力的灵活组合。与现有机器人智能体框架不同，ThinkLocoManip明确将移动（locomotion）作为智能体推理与执行的一个工具域。我们进一步设计了一套技能，既显式考虑了各功能域内的工具使用，也兼顾了跨域协同，从而支持在长时间跨度内有效执行复杂行为。为应对长时程交互中的任务失败问题，我们提出了关键帧思考机制，以保留关键执行上下文并支持高效的错误恢复。大量真实世界实验表明，在具有挑战性的长时程腿式移动操作任务中，ThinkLocoManip在性能上显著优于基于直接动作生成和“先规划后执行”范式的代表性方法。值得注意的是，ThinkLocoManip的成功率达到77%，是最强的“先规划后执行”基线方法（37.1%）的两倍以上。我们的实验进一步验证了交错推理与执行、工具编排以及技能协同执行的有效性。

title: AdaPolicy: Action-Driven Anticipatory Robot Policies via Next-Chunk Prediction
summary: Endowing robot policies with anticipatory capabilities has proven effective in improving control performance. However, existing methods predominantly rely on explicit supervision derived from future observations, in either pixel or latent space, at the cost of additional architectural and computational complexity. Departing from explicit future supervision, we ask whether such foresight can be elicited directly from the action signal. To this end, we propose \textbf{AdaPolicy}, an \textbf{A}ction-\textbf{d}riven \textbf{a}nticipatory policy framework that shapes future-aware representations via cascaded next-chunk prediction. Specifically, an Online Action Head jointly produces the current action chunk and an evolved latent state. Building on this state, a cascaded Unrolled Action Head forecasts the next chunk, and the resulting loss flows back through the evolved state to instill implicit foresight into the online policy. Importantly, this training-only unroll requires no future-observation encoding, keeping AdaPolicy lightweight to train with zero inference-time overhead. Experiments on MetaWorld, RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world deployments demonstrate consistent gains across diverse settings, including up to $14$ percentage points on millimeter-precision tasks such as earphone assembly and shoelace threading. More details and visualizations are available at \href{https://teee111.github.io/AdaPolicy/}{https://teee111.github.io/AdaPolicy/}.
tldr: AdaPolicy introduces a lightweight action-driven anticipatory policy that uses cascaded next-chunk prediction to instill implicit foresight into robot policies without future-observation encoding, achieving consistent gains on benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: AdaPolicy 提出了一种轻量级的动作驱动预测策略，通过级联下一块预测将隐式预见性注入机器人策略，无需未来观测编码，在基准测试和真实任务中均取得一致提升。
summary_zh: 为机器人策略赋予预判能力已被证明能有效提升控制性能。然而，现有方法主要依赖于从未来观测中提取的显式监督信号，无论是在像素空间还是潜空间中，这都以增加架构和计算复杂性为代价。与显式未来监督不同，我们探讨是否可以直接从动作信号中引出这种前瞻能力。为此，我们提出 \textbf{AdaPolicy}，一种 \textbf{动}作驱动的\textbf{预}判策略框架，通过级联的下一片段预测来塑造具未来感知的表征。具体而言，在线动作头同时产生当前动作片段和一个演化后的潜状态。在此基础上，级联的展开动作头预测下一片段，所产生的损失通过演化状态反向传播，从而将隐式前瞻能力注入在线策略中。重要的是，这种仅存在于训练阶段的展开过程无需编码未来观测，使得 AdaPolicy 保持轻量，且在推理阶段零额外开销。在 MetaWorld、RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 以及真实世界部署上的实验表明，该方法在多种场景下均带来一致的性能提升，在毫米级精度任务（如耳机装配和鞋带穿引）上提升了多达 14 个百分点。更多细节和可视化结果请参见 \href{https://teee111.github.io/AdaPolicy/}{https://teee111.github.io/AdaPolicy/}。

title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
summary: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.
tldr: HuGe pre-trains humanoid generalist VLAs on 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data, using a three-stage pipeline with pseudo-proprioception and visual adaptation to transfer across embodiments, achieving state-of-the-art results on HumanoidArena and real-world Unitree G1 pick-and-drop tasks.
tldr_zh: HuGe在超过2000小时的自我中心人类和机器人数据上预训练人形通用VLA模型，通过三阶段训练流程（包括伪本体感觉和视觉适配）实现跨实体迁移，在HumanoidArena基准和Unitree G1真实世界任务中达到领先水平。
summary_zh: 将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）扩展至人形机器人，需要协调的全身控制以及多样化的示范数据，而这些数据在真实场景中采集成本高昂。尽管以自我为中心的真人示范为任务经验提供了补充来源，但视觉具身差异以及机器人本体感觉信息的缺失，使得向人形策略的迁移变得复杂。为解决上述挑战，我们提出了HuGe——一族基于超过2000小时自我中心人类数据与机器人数据预训练的人形通用VLA模型。具体而言，HuGe采用三种现有代表性VLA架构，为预训练的全身控制器预测潜在运动令牌，并同时生成手部控制信号。在此基础上，我们引入了一种三阶段训练流程，将自我中心预训练、人形适配以及下游微调相结合。为促进跨具身迁移，我们在预训练阶段通过仿真回放构建伪本体感觉状态，并在下游微调阶段通过重新渲染调整自我中心观测中的手臂外观。借助该流程，HuGe在仿真基准HumanoidArena上达到了当前最优性能。此外，在Unitree G1上的真实世界实验表明，将经视觉适配的自我中心示范与机器人示范相结合，可显著提升拾取-放置任务的成功率。

title: PS-DLO: Property- and Spatially Aware Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Policy
summary: Deformable linear objects (DLO) pose a coupled perception and control challenge: their slender geometry makes precise localization difficult, while their deformations depend on object-specific physical properties. To address this challenge, we propose PS-DLO, a property- and spatially aware DLO manipulation policy. First, contrastive image-text learning maps the initial observation to categorical descriptions of DLO properties, providing explicit physical and structural priors for action generation. Second, SAM3 extracts mask-guided features from future observations, which are distilled into the policy's action expert to encode task-relevant DLO regions and their subsequent configurations. We evaluate PS-DLO on nine real-world tasks across single-arm and bimanual platforms, training a shared multi-task policy for each embodiment. PS-DLO achieves an average success rate of 68.9%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 20.0 percentage points. In generalization experiments, PS-DLO achieves higher success rates than the baseline in six of seven visual-shift conditions on butterfly-knot untying. These results demonstrate that combining object-property priors with future spatial supervision improves multi-task DLO manipulation and robustness to visual variation.
tldr: PS-DLO introduces a property- and spatially aware policy for deformable linear object manipulation, using contrastive image-text learning to infer DLO properties and SAM3-based mask-guided future distillation, achieving 68.9% average success on nine real-world tasks and outperforming baselines by 20 percentage points.
tldr_zh: PS-DLO提出了一种面向变形线性物体操作的属性与空间感知策略，通过对比图文学习推断DLO属性，并利用SAM3掩码引导的未来蒸馏，在九个真实世界任务中平均成功率达68.9%，比最强基线高出20个百分点。
summary_zh: 可变形线性物体（DLO）带来了感知与控制相互耦合的挑战：其细长几何结构使得精确定位困难，而其形变则依赖于物体特有的物理属性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了PS-DLO，一种具备属性感知与空间感知的DLO操作策略。首先，对比式图像-文本学习将初始观测映射为DLO属性的分类描述，为动作生成提供明确的物理与结构先验。其次，SAM3从未来观测中提取掩码引导特征，并将其蒸馏到策略的动作专家中，以编码任务相关的DLO区域及其后续构型。我们在单臂和双臂平台上对PS-DLO进行了九项真实世界任务的评估，并为每种执行平台训练了一个共享的多任务策略。PS-DLO平均成功率达到68.9%，比最强基线高出20.0个百分点。在泛化实验中，PS-DLO在蝴蝶结解结任务的七种视觉偏移条件下，有六种条件的成功率均高于基线。这些结果表明，将物体属性先验与未来空间监督相结合，能够提升多任务DLO操作性能及其对视觉变化的鲁棒性。

title: HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
summary: Humanoid robots have recently achieved remarkable success in motion tracking. However, during real-world deployment, robots inevitably encounter dynamics gaps arising from either extra physical disturbances or inaccurate simulation modeling, resulting in a significant training-deployment gap. Therefore, effectively leveraging real-world data to fine-tune policies represents the crucial last mile for robust deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose HumanoidNDM, an online fine-tuning framework for humanoid motion tracking driven by a real-world-trained neural dynamics model. First, in the data collection stage, we introduce a low-frequency reference perturbation method with an adaptive intensity mechanism, balancing deployment feasibility and exploration efficiency. Second, for the model training stage, we train a robust history-based, proprioceptive neural dynamics model in Euclidean space by incorporating differentiable forward kinematics, eliminating the reliance on costly motion capture systems. Finally, in the policy fine-tuning stage, we directly fine-tune the policy via backpropagated model gradients, achieving high data efficiency. Through physical validation on the Unitree G1 robot, we demonstrate that HumanoidNDM enables rapid real-world adaptation to various perturbations, representing the first online, MoCap-free fine-tuning framework for humanoid tracking policies.
tldr: HumanoidNDM proposes an online, MoCap-free fine-tuning framework for humanoid motion tracking policies that uses a real-world-trained neural dynamics model to close the training-deployment gap, validated on a Unitree G1 robot under physical perturbations.
tldr_zh: HumanoidNDM 提出了一种无需动作捕捉系统的在线微调框架，利用真实世界训练的神经动力学模型来弥合人形机器人运动跟踪策略的训练与部署差距，并在 Unitree G1 机器人上进行了物理验证。
summary_zh: 人形机器人近年来在运动跟踪方面取得了显著成功。然而，在实际部署过程中，机器人不可避免地会遭遇由额外物理干扰或仿真建模不准确引起的动力学差异，从而导致训练与部署之间存在显著差距。因此，有效利用真实世界数据对策略进行微调，是实现稳健部署的关键“最后一公里”。为弥合这一差距，我们提出HumanoidNDM，一种由真实世界训练的神经动力学模型驱动的在线微调框架，用于人形机器人运动跟踪。首先，在数据采集阶段，我们引入一种带有自适应强度机制的低频参考扰动方法，兼顾部署可行性与探索效率。其次，在模型训练阶段，我们通过在欧几里得空间中融入可微正运动学，训练一个基于历史信息的鲁棒本体感觉神经动力学模型，从而消除对昂贵动作捕捉系统的依赖。最后，在策略微调阶段，我们通过反向传播的模型梯度直接对策略进行微调，实现高数据效率。通过在宇树G1机器人上的物理验证，我们证明HumanoidNDM能够实现对多种扰动的快速真实世界自适应，代表了首个在线、无需动作捕捉的人形机器人跟踪策略微调框架。

title: X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Variable-View Robot Control
summary: Video diffusion models provide a source of interaction representations for robot control, but transferring these representations requires reconciling variable camera inputs with heterogeneous action interfaces and closed-loop execution. We present X-World, a framework that transfers a video prior through a fixed-length token sequence to a shared action expert. A residual cross-view attention branch extends a pretrained video backbone to one, two, or three views while retaining its original self-attention path. A layer-aligned Q-Former aggregates backbone features, and dataset-specific modules map between native state and action interfaces and the shared action expert. Training separates video adaptation from action-only pretraining by freezing the video backbone in the latter stage, followed by joint target-domain post-training. The policy extracts video features with a single backbone pass and uses asynchronous action chunking for execution. On LIBERO, X-World reaches 98.5\% mean success; its LIBERO-trained checkpoint obtains 76.5\% on LIBERO-Plus without further adaptation. The seven-shift breakdown reveals gains in robot, language, lighting, and layout perturbations, alongside weaknesses under camera, background, and noise shifts relative to OpenVLA-OFT. On six dual-arm real-world tasks, it achieves 81.7\% mean success over 20 trials per task. Removing video adaptation or cross-view fusion produces the largest observed success drops among the tested removals.
tldr: X-World transfers video diffusion priors to variable-view robot control via a fixed-length token sequence and residual cross-view attention, achieving strong LIBERO and real-world dual-arm manipulation success rates.
tldr_zh: X-World 通过固定长度 token 序列和残差跨视角注意力，将视频扩散先验迁移到可变视角机器人控制，在 LIBERO 和真实双臂操作中取得了很高的成功率。
summary_zh: 视频扩散模型为机器人控制提供了一种交互表征来源，但迁移这些表征需要协调可变的相机输入、异构的动作接口以及闭环执行。我们提出了X-World，一个通过固定长度的token序列将视频先验迁移至共享动作专家的框架。一个残差跨视角注意力分支将预训练的视频骨干网络扩展至单视角、双视角或三视角，同时保留其原有的自注意力路径。一个层级对齐的Q-Former聚合骨干网络特征，而数据集专用模块则在原生状态与动作接口和共享动作专家之间进行映射。训练过程将视频适配与仅动作预训练分离，在后一阶段冻结视频骨干网络，随后进行联合目标域后训练。该策略通过单次骨干网络前向传播提取视频特征，并使用异步动作分块进行执行。在LIBERO上，X-World达到了98.5%的平均成功率；其LIBERO训练检查点在无需进一步适配的情况下，在LIBERO-Plus上取得了76.5%的成功率。七项偏移分解结果显示了在机器人、语言、光照和布局扰动上的增益，同时揭示了相较于OpenVLA-OFT在相机、背景和噪声偏移下的不足。在六项双臂真实世界任务中，每项任务20次试验，平均成功率达到81.7%。在各项消融测试中，移除视频适配或跨视角融合导致了观察到的最大成功率下降。

title: I Won't Know Until I Try: Interactive Information Gathering for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon manipulation often depends on object properties that cannot be reliably inferred from appearance alone. Physical interaction can reveal these properties, but it can also change the world in ways that invalidate subsequent actions. We present a task and motion planning (TAMP) framework that integrates task-directed interactive information-gathering with interleaved planning and execution. Building on PDDLStream, our framework plans optimistically with these interactive actions, verifies their outcomes during execution, and adapts the remaining plan by retaining still-applicable actions and replanning only the connections needed to continue execution. We evaluate the framework in simulation and on a real robot across tasks that require determining whether an object is movable, a pen has ink, a drawer can be opened, or a container is empty. These experiments demonstrate how interaction-driven state updates and recovery replanning support continued execution under uncertain outcomes and external disturbances.
tldr: This paper presents a TAMP framework that integrates task-directed interactive information gathering with interleaved planning and execution for long-horizon manipulation, enabling robots to verify uncertain object properties through physical interaction and replan adaptively. Evaluations in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in handling uncertain outcomes and external disturbances.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种任务与运动规划（TAMP）框架，将任务导向的交互式信息收集与交错规划和执行相结合，用于长时间跨度的操作任务，使机器人能够通过物理交互验证不确定的对象属性并自适应地重新规划。在仿真和真实机器人上的实验证明了该框架在处理不确定结果和外部干扰方面的有效性。
summary_zh: 长时程操作往往依赖于无法仅凭外观可靠推断的物体属性。物理交互可以揭示这些属性，但也可能以某种方式改变世界，从而使后续动作失效。我们提出了一种任务与运动规划（TAMP）框架，该框架将任务导向的交互式信息收集与交错规划和执行相结合。基于PDDLStream，我们的框架以乐观态度规划这些交互动作，在执行过程中验证其结果，并通过保留仍然适用的动作、仅重新规划继续执行所需的连接来调整剩余计划。我们在仿真环境和真实机器人上对该框架进行了评估，涉及的任务包括确定物体是否可移动、钢笔是否有墨水、抽屉能否打开或容器是否为空。这些实验证明了在不确定结果和外部干扰下，交互驱动的状态更新和恢复重规划如何支持持续执行。

title: RoboLongR: Causally Consistent Rewards Teach Robots to Progressively Master Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon manipulation requires actions whose validity depends on earlier interactions, yet visual progress can conceal missing task prerequisites. We propose RoboLongR, an offline-to-online framework that learns history-dependent rewards to guide policy adaptation to new tasks. Its central objective is causal consistency: aligning rewarded progress with prerequisites supported by execution history. Stage-shuffle supervision encourages execution-order sensitivity, recurrent memory preserves evidence of earlier interactions, and two-round training refines trajectory segments using predicted progress. The resulting rewards guide stage-conditioned policy refinement from behavior cloning to online reinforcement learning. Sparse terminal feedback connects policy experience to reward learning by triggering correction for repeated high-scoring failures. Pretrained on demonstrations from 88 RLBench tasks and Open-X data, RoboLongR achieves 31.8% average success on 18 long-horizon tasks excluded from reward pretraining, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.2 percentage points. Across four real-robot tasks, it achieves 57.5% success, a 32.5-percentage-point improvement over the comparison method. Reward-level controls probe sensitivity to synthetic order perturbations, while ablations examine the contributions of individual components to policy improvement.
tldr: RoboLongR introduces a causal-consistency reward learning framework with history-dependent rewards and stage-conditioned policy refinement, improving long-horizon manipulation success on simulated RLBench tasks and real robots.
tldr_zh: RoboLongR 提出了一种具有因果一致性奖励学习框架，通过历史依赖奖励和阶段条件的策略优化，在模拟 RLBench 任务和真实机器人上提升了长期操作的成功率。
summary_zh: 长程操作任务要求动作的有效性依赖于早期的交互，然而视觉进展可能掩盖缺失的任务前提条件。我们提出RoboLongR，一种从离线到在线的框架，通过学习依赖于历史进程的奖励来引导策略适应新任务。其核心目标是因果一致性：使奖励进展与执行历史所支持的前提条件保持一致。阶段混洗监督机制增强了对执行顺序的敏感性，循环记忆保留早期交互的证据，两轮训练利用预测进展细化轨迹片段。由此产生的奖励引导从行为克隆到在线强化学习的阶段条件化策略精炼。稀疏的终端反馈通过触发对重复高分失败的纠正，将策略经验与奖励学习联系起来。在88个RLBench任务和Open-X数据的演示上预训练后，RoboLongR在18个未参与奖励预训练的长程任务上平均成功率达31.8%，超过最强基线方法9.2个百分点。在四个真实机器人任务中，其成功率达57.5%，相较对比方法提升32.5个百分点。奖励层面的控制实验检验了对合成顺序扰动的敏感性，消融研究则考察了各组件对策略改进的贡献。

title: AdaDexTrack: Dynamic Modulation for Adaptive and Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Tracking
summary: Language is a natural way to command robots, but converting a single instruction into a long-horizon, contact-rich hand-object interaction remains challenging: synthesized references are noisy, human-to-robot retargeting introduces embodiment bias, and fixed-reference tracking lets small errors snowball. We address this with AdaDexTrack, a modulator-in-the-loop framework for language-conditioned manipulation tracking. A distilled generalist tracker serves as the skill carrier, while a tightly aligned modulator performs three feedback corrections: reference modulation (continual adjustment of what to track), object-latent modulation (online adaptation of the object representation to recruit suitable skills), and positional-target modulation (small state-dependent refinements for execution). The tracker is learned via large-scale specialist to generalist distillation on a corpus of language-conditioned hand-object trajectories; the modulator is trained with RL under the same task objective, ensuring tight coupling. Across large-scale evaluations, AdaDexTrack consistently outperforms prior SOTA on unseen-trajectory and unseen-object sets in both average tracking error and success rate, demonstrating robustness and generalization. We further show zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on real hardware, where adding the modulator yields substantial gains over a tracker-only variant. AdaDexTrack reframes language-conditioned dexterous manipulation as modulated tracking, replacing the open-loop, fixed-reference tracking with in-loop modulation that adjusts the reference, object latent, and positional target, yielding drift-resistant execution from noisy text references.
tldr: AdaDexTrack introduces a modulator-in-the-loop framework for language-conditioned dexterous manipulation tracking, dynamically adjusting references, object latents, and positional targets to achieve robust and generalizable control, with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: AdaDexTrack 提出一种基于调制器回路的框架，用于语言条件灵巧操作跟踪，通过动态调整参考、对象潜在表示和位置目标，实现稳健且可泛化的控制，并支持零样本仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 语言是操控机器人的自然方式，但将单条指令转化为长时程、富含接触的手-物交互仍具挑战性：合成参考噪声大，人-机器人重定向引入具身偏差，而固定参考跟踪会使小误差不断累积。我们提出AdaDexTrack，一种面向语言条件操控跟踪的调制器在环框架。蒸馏得到的泛化专家跟踪器作为技能载体，而紧密对齐的调制器执行三类反馈修正：参考调制（持续调整跟踪目标）、物体潜在调制（在线调整物体表征以调用合适技能）以及位置目标调制（面向执行的小幅状态相关精修）。跟踪器通过在语言条件手-物轨迹语料库上进行大规模“专家到泛化者”蒸馏学习；调制器则在相同任务目标下通过强化学习训练，确保二者紧密耦合。在大规模评估中，AdaDexTrack在未见轨迹集和未见物体集上的平均跟踪误差与成功率方面均持续优于先前最优方法，展现出鲁棒性与泛化能力。我们进一步在真实硬件上展示了零样本仿真到现实的迁移，添加调制器相比仅跟踪器变体带来了显著增益。AdaDexTrack将语言条件的灵巧操控重新定义为调制跟踪，以在环调制替代开环、固定参考跟踪，动态调整参考、物体潜在表示及位置目标，从而在嘈杂文本参考下实现抗漂移执行。

title: Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. Existing methods either rely on implicit temporal representations within policy networks, where historical information can be gradually diluted, or maintain explicit memory buffers that suffer from redundancy, noise accumulation, and inefficient retrieval. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information. Our approach encodes multimodal trajectories into compact latent memory representations through a selective state- space memory encoder, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression. During action generation, dynamic cross-attention retrieval with gated fusion adaptively incorporates relevant memories into policy prediction. With merely 3.45M additional parameters, CogMemory stays lightweight and seamlessly fits both early- and intermediate-fusion VLA backbones. Extensive experiments on long-horizon robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse VLA backbones.
tldr: CogMemory introduces a variational cognitive memory framework with selective state-space encoding, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational compression, enabling lightweight and effective long-horizon memory for VLA models, consistently improving performance across backbones on robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: CogMemory 提出了一种变分认知记忆框架，通过选择性状态空间编码、多槽时间抽象和变分信息压缩，为 VLA 模型提供轻量级且有效的长期记忆，在机器人操作基准上持续提升多种骨干网络的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域取得了显著成功，然而其在执行长时程任务方面的能力仍受限于长期记忆建模的不足。现有方法要么依赖策略网络内部的隐式时序表征，导致历史信息逐渐稀释；要么维护显式记忆缓冲区，却面临冗余、噪声累积以及检索效率低下的问题。本文提出了CogMemory——一种新颖的变分认知记忆框架，使VLA系统能够选择性保留并复用与任务相关的历史信息。该方法通过选择性状态空间记忆编码器、多槽位时间抽象以及变分信息压缩，将多模态轨迹编码为紧凑的潜在记忆表征。在动作生成阶段，采用动态交叉注意力检索与门控融合机制，将相关记忆自适应地融入策略预测。CogMemory仅增加3.45M参数，保持轻量化的同时，可无缝适配早期融合与中期融合的VLA骨干网络。在长时程机器人操作基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在不同VLA骨干网络上均取得了一致的性能提升。

title: TurboWAM: Learning What Matters for Fast World Action Models
summary: World action models have demonstrated promising performance in robot policy learning, yet their high inference latency remains a critical bottleneck for real-world deployment. Recent approaches have sought to improve inference efficiency by reducing test-time future-frame imagination or accelerating action prediction. However, these methods often leverage representations from all video world model layers without explicitly considering their varying relevance to action prediction, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal representation utilization. In this work, we propose TurboWAM, a fast world action model that efficiently aggregates structured world representations conditioned on action predictions. Specifically, TurboWAM introduces a structured world representation aggregation module that adaptively fuses representations from different world model layers according to their relevance to the evolving action denoising state. Furthermore, TurboWAM employs a structured action supervision mechanism that adaptively modulates gradients from action supervision across different world model layers during backward propagation, facilitating world representation learning. During inference, by reducing the number of world model layers executed and caching relevant representations across action denoising steps, TurboWAM substantially reduces computational overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that TurboWAM achieves low inference latency while maintaining competitive task success rates compared with state-of-the-art methods.
tldr: TurboWAM improves the inference efficiency of world action models for robot manipulation by adaptively aggregating world model layer representations based on action prediction relevance and caching computations, achieving lower latency without sacrificing task success rates.
tldr_zh: TurboWAM通过根据动作预测相关性自适应聚合世界模型层表示并缓存计算，提高了机器人操作中世界动作模型的推理效率，在保持任务成功率的同时降低了延迟。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型在机器人策略学习中展现出了良好的性能，然而其高推理延迟仍是实际部署中的关键瓶颈。近期研究尝试通过减少测试阶段的未来帧想象或加速动作预测来提升推理效率。然而，这些方法通常不加区分地利用视频世界模型所有层的表示，未明确考虑这些表示对动作预测的相关性差异，从而导致冗余计算和表示利用不充分。在本工作中，我们提出了TurboWAM——一种以动作预测为条件、高效聚合结构化世界表示的快速世界动作模型。具体而言，TurboWAM引入了一个结构化世界表示聚合模块，该模块根据各层世界模型表示与动态动作去噪状态的相关性，自适应地融合来自不同世界模型层的表示。此外，TurboWAM采用了一种结构化动作监督机制，在反向传播过程中自适应地调节来自动作监督的梯度在不同世界模型层间的传播，从而促进世界表示的学习。在推理阶段，通过减少执行的世界模型层数并在动作去噪步骤间缓存相关表示，TurboWAM显著降低了计算开销。在多个机器人操作基准上的大量实验表明，TurboWAM在保持与最先进方法相当的任成功率的同时，实现了低推理延迟。

title: WMEval: Evaluating Interactive World Models Grounded on Physical Simulations
summary: Interactive world models hold immense potential for high-stakes applications in robotics, game engines, and immersive digital twins, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual similarity rather than the physical-causal coherence essential for real-world utility. We introduce WMEval, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates interactive world models against Unity-based physical simulations. By leveraging Unity as a high-fidelity ground-truth oracle, we shift evaluation beyond perceptual visual assessment toward the objective state-based verification required for downstream applications. Spanning 9 diverse scenes, WMEval assesses action controllability, scene and character consistency, prompt adherence, kinematics, fluid mechanics, physical causality, and lighting. By executing matched action sequences in both the simulator and the world model, WMEval enables evaluation at both the perceptual level and the physical-causal level, using simulator-derived states as reference. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal significant room for improvement in dimensions that remain hidden by standard perceptual metrics but are vital for real-world deployments. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/WMEval.
tldr: WMEval is a benchmark that uses Unity-based physical simulations to evaluate interactive world models, shifting focus from perceptual similarity to physical-causal coherence and state-based verification across nine scenes.
tldr_zh: WMEval 是一个基于 Unity 物理模拟的基准，用于评估交互式世界模型，将评估焦点从感知相似性转向物理因果一致性和基于状态的验证。
summary_zh: 交互式世界模型在机器人、游戏引擎和沉浸式数字孪生等高危应用中具有巨大潜力，然而现有基准测试主要关注感知相似性，而非实际应用所必需的物理因果一致性。我们提出了WMEval，一个基于Unity物理仿真的全面基准测试，用于评估交互式世界模型。通过利用Unity作为高保真真值基准，我们将评估从感知视觉层面转向下游应用所需的客观状态验证。WMEval涵盖9个多样化场景，评估动作可控性、场景与角色一致性、提示遵循度、运动学、流体力学、物理因果关系以及光照效果。通过在模拟器和世界模型中执行匹配的动作序列，WMEval能够在感知层面和物理因果层面进行评估，并以模拟器生成的状态作为参考。对最先进模型的实验结果表明，在标准感知指标难以揭示但对实际部署至关重要的维度上，仍存在显著的改进空间。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/WMEval。

title: AuRA: From Atoms to Bits through Autonomous Robot Interaction
summary: Simulation enables robot-learning experiments at scale, but acquiring physics-informed digital twins often requires human manipulation and manual annotation of recorded interactions. To reduce this reliance on human effort, we present AuRA, a system that automates robot interaction and data preparation for digital-twin reconstruction. AuRA combines execution-aware grasp selection, gripper-motion measurements derived from robot states, and registered pre-interaction geometry and appearance priors. These choices enable autonomous collection, avoid reliance on visual gripper tracking, and recover object information obscured by the robot. Across 13 deformable objects, AuRA reduces active human labor and wall-clock collection time per successfully reconstructed asset by 88.5% and 55.4%, respectively. Relative to the human-collected PhysTwin baseline, AuRA improves seven of nine metrics for future prediction under known gripper motion, including a 28.1% reduction in one-way $L_1$ Chamfer distance. It also achieves similar mean silhouette IoU and Chamfer distance under the evaluated unseen interactions. These results highlight the potential of autonomous robot interaction to support more efficient digital-twin acquisition with comparable reconstruction quality.
tldr: AuRA is a system that automates robot interaction and data collection for reconstructing physics-informed digital twins of deformable objects, reducing human labor and collection time while maintaining reconstruction quality.
tldr_zh: AuRA是一个自动化机器人交互和数据收集系统，用于重建可变形物体的物理数字孪生，减少人工劳动和采集时间，同时保持重建质量。
summary_zh: 仿真技术使机器人学习实验能够大规模开展，但获取符合物理规律的数字孪生模型往往需要人工操作，并对记录到的交互过程进行手动标注。为减少对人力的依赖，我们提出了AuRA系统，该系统可自动化机器人交互过程及数据准备工作，以支持数字孪生重建。AuRA结合了考虑执行能力的抓取选择、由机器人状态推导出的夹爪运动测量，以及配准后的交互前几何与外观先验信息。这些设计选择使得数据采集可以自主进行，无需依赖视觉夹爪跟踪，并能恢复被机器人遮挡的对象信息。在13个可变形对象上，AuRA使每个成功重建资产所需的主动人工劳动时间和实际采集时间分别减少了88.5%和55.4%。与人工采集的PhysTwin基准相比，AuRA在已知夹爪运动条件下的未来预测中，九项指标中有七项得到提升，其中单向$L_1$ Chamfer距离降低了28.1%。在评估的未见交互场景下，AuRA也达到了相近的平均轮廓IoU和Chamfer距离。这些结果凸显了自主机器人交互在提高数字孪生采集效率、同时保持可比重建质量方面的潜力。

title: EAST: Embodied AI Safety Testing via Systematic Fault Injection in Digital Twins
summary: Task success is not a sufficient measure of safety for embodied artificial intelligence (AI), because robots may complete objectives while violating safety requirements. Existing evaluations often emphasize performance and robustness, but lack a systematic route from documented safety hazards to executable, verifiable tests. We present EAST (Embodied AI Safety Testing), a digital-twin framework that converts literature-grounded safety evidence into fault-injection tests across perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing. EAST combines an expert-reviewed safety-fault taxonomy and eight executable operators with applicability and validity constraints. Its three-stage workflow generates test specifications, verifies fault realization during simulated execution, and independently assesses safety challenges, violations, task outcomes, and behavioral signatures using simulator-state evidence. The framework preserves execution traces and replayable records, supporting attribution and reproducibility across experiments. We evaluate EAST on six RoboTwin manipulation tasks and two policy architectures, ACT and RDT, against alternative testing strategies under matched budgets. Across five comparative campaigns, EAST targets all 74 admissible task-policy-operator combinations and obtains valid evidence for 63, while achieving safety-challenge exposure rates close to Random-Legal and Rule-Based. Moreover, 82 valid EAST executions complete their tasks despite safety violations, revealing risks concealed by success-oriented evaluation. These findings support systematic, validity-aware, reproducible safety testing beyond task-completion metrics.
tldr: EAST is a digital-twin framework for embodied AI safety testing that converts literature-grounded safety hazards into fault-injection tests across perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing, and evaluates on RoboTwin manipulation tasks with ACT and RDT policies.
tldr_zh: EAST是一个数字孪生框架，用于具身AI安全测试，将文献中的安全危害转化为跨感知、指令、环境、动作和时间的故障注入测试，并在RoboTwin操作任务上评估ACT和RDT策略。
summary_zh: 任务成功并不足以衡量具身人工智能（AI）的安全性，因为机器人可能在完成目标的同时违反安全要求。现有评估通常强调性能和鲁棒性，但缺乏从已记录的安全隐患到可执行、可验证测试的系统性路径。我们提出EAST（具身AI安全测试），一个数字孪生框架，将基于文献的安全证据转化为跨感知、指令、环境、动作和时机的故障注入测试。EAST结合了经专家评审的安全故障分类法和八个可执行算子，并附有适用性和有效性约束。其三阶段工作流生成测试规范，在模拟执行期间验证故障实现，并利用模拟器状态证据独立评估安全挑战、违规行为、任务结果和行为特征。该框架保留执行轨迹和可重放记录，支持跨实验的归因和可复现性。我们在六个RoboTwin操作任务和两种策略架构（ACT和RDT）上，在匹配预算下与替代测试策略进行比较，评估EAST。在五次对比实验中，EAST覆盖了全部74个可采用的“任务-策略-算子”组合，并为其中63个获得了有效证据，同时安全挑战暴露率接近随机合法和基于规则的方法。此外，82次有效的EAST执行在存在安全违规的情况下仍完成了任务，揭示了以成功为导向的评估所掩盖的风险。这些发现支持超越任务完成指标的系统性、有效性感知、可复现的安全测试。

title: ScheNav: Schematic-Guided Object Goal Navigation
summary: Object goal navigation requires an embodied agent to locate and reach target objects in complex environments. Humans often rely on low-cost yet informative schematic maps, such as rough sketches or directional annotations. We develop a workflow for schematic-guided embodied navigation with two components: a training-data generation pipeline and ScheNav, a closed-loop navigation framework. Our lightweight data-generation pipeline turns 2D floorplans into navigation training environments, yielding Furnished-RPLAN, a dataset of over 33k furnished layouts with paired navigation episodes and noise-controllable schematic maps. ScheNav turns rough schematic guidance into exploration and stopping decisions by using SchemaField, a learned spatial module that fuses the guidance with accumulated observations and predicts spatial value fields. The framework updates these fields as exploration proceeds, with trajectory-based training and a cross-frame consistency objective supporting coherent guidance across changing viewpoints. ScheNav learns to use schematic guidance entirely from simulated floorplans and transfers this ability to unseen embodied environments. Experiments show improved navigation success and path efficiency across schematic maps, goal ellipses, and pointed directions, together with tolerance to the tested schematic perturbations and omissions. Together, these results demonstrate that rough schematic guidance offers a practical way to improve embodied navigation.
tldr: This paper introduces ScheNav, a closed-loop navigation framework that uses rough schematic maps (sketches, goal ellipses, arrow directions) as lightweight guidance to improve object goal navigation, with a data generation pipeline that creates Furnished-RPLAN and a learned SchemaField module for spatial value prediction. Experiments show improved success and path efficiency in unseen embodied environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ScheNav，一种利用粗略示意图（草图、目标椭圆、箭头方向）作为轻量级指导来提升物体目标导航的闭环导航框架，并配套数据生成流程构建Furnished-RPLAN数据集和SchemaField模块以预测空间价值场。实验表明在未知环境中导航成功率和路径效率均有提升。
summary_zh: 目标导航要求具身智能体在复杂环境中定位并到达目标物体。人类通常依赖成本低廉但信息丰富的示意性地图，例如粗略草图或方向标注。我们开发了一套面向示意图引导的具身导航工作流，包含两个组成部分：训练数据生成流水线和ScheNav闭环导航框架。我们的轻量化数据生成流水线将二维平面图转化为导航训练环境，生成了Furnished-RPLAN数据集，其中包含超过33,000个带配对导航任务片段及可控噪声示意图的家具布局。ScheNav通过SchemaField（一个学习得到的空间模块）将粗略的示意性引导转化为探索与停止决策，该模块将引导信息与累积观测相融合，并预测空间价值场。随着探索的推进，该框架不断更新这些场，并借助基于轨迹的训练和跨帧一致性目标，在不同视角变化下提供连贯的引导。ScheNav完全在模拟平面图中学习使用示意图引导，并将这一能力迁移到未见过的具身环境中。实验结果表明，在示意图地图、目标椭圆和指向方向等条件下，导航成功率和路径效率均有提升，同时展现了在所述示意图扰动与信息缺失情况下的耐受性。上述结果共同表明，粗略的示意图引导为改进具身导航提供了一种切实可行的方法。

title: DSGN: A Dual-Stream Gated Network for Scalable Simultaneous Surveillance and Containment
summary: The simultaneous surveillance and containment (SSC) problem arises in multi-robot applications such as perimeter security and environmental monitoring, where robots must survey a region of interest and coordinate to enclose targets once they are detected. Surveillance favors spatial dispersion for coverage, whereas containment requires target-centric cohesion for enclosure. This conflict makes heuristic switching unstable, and the instability becomes more pronounced as larger robotic networks introduce more inter-agent and agent-target relations. End-to-end DRL reduces reliance on hand-crafted switching, but conventional single-stream policies often mix surveillance and containment cues in one shared feature space that could entangle dispersion-oriented and target-centric signals and weaken task transitions. In this paper, we propose the Dual-Stream Gated Network (DSGN), an architecture designed to address scale-amplified task-transition difficulties by separating surveillance and containment into specialized representation streams and coordinating them through a context-aware gating mechanism. A probabilistic prior further regularizes the gating process, reducing ambiguous intermediate decisions and supporting clearer behavioral transitions under large-scale interaction complexity. Evaluations show that DSGN maintains strong task efficacy and scalability under constant-density cross-scale settings. Additional ablation and phase-specific evaluations show that the proposed dynamic gating mechanism and probabilistic prior support effective task arbitration and reliable mode switching in both pure surveillance and task-switching scenarios. The source code is available at https://github.com/zuozysama/DSGN.
tldr: This paper introduces DSGN, a dual-stream gated network for multi-robot simultaneous surveillance and containment, using specialized representation streams and a context-aware gating mechanism with a probabilistic prior to handle scalable task transitions in large robotic networks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DSGN，一种用于多机器人同时监视与围堵的双流门控网络，通过专用表示流和结合概率先验的上下文感知门控机制，应对大规模机器人网络中任务切换的扩展性难题。
summary_zh: 监视与围堵同步（SSC）问题出现在多机器人应用中，如周界安防和环境监测，在这些场景中，机器人必须侦察感兴趣的区域，并在检测到目标后协调围堵。监视倾向于空间分散以扩大覆盖面，而围堵则需要以目标为中心的聚合以实现包围。这一冲突导致启发式切换不稳定，而随着更大规模的机器人网络引入更多的智能体间及智能体-目标间关系，这种不稳定性愈发显著。端到端深度强化学习减少了对人工设计切换的依赖，但传统的单流策略往往将监视和围堵线索混合在一个共享的特征空间中，这可能会纠缠分散导向信号与目标中心信号，并削弱任务切换能力。本文提出了双流门控网络（DSGN），该架构通过将监视和围堵分离为专门的表示流，并通过上下文感知门控机制进行协调，从而解决规模放大的任务切换难题。概率先验进一步规范了门控过程，减少模糊的中间决策，并在大规模交互复杂性下支持更清晰的行为转换。评估表明，DSGN在恒定密度跨尺度设置下保持了较强的任务效能和可扩展性。额外的消融实验和分阶段评估表明，所提出的动态门控机制和概率先验在纯监视和任务切换场景中均支持有效的任务仲裁和可靠的模式切换。源代码可在 https://github.com/zuozysama/DSGN 获取。

title: Learning Interaction-Aware Path Corrections from Unlabeled Trajectories: A LiDAR-Based Sim-to-Real GNN Framework for Construction Robots
summary: Construction robots operating near workers require navigation that can anticipate human motion while remaining robust to dynamic and unstructured site conditions. However, existing social navigation methods depend on hand-crafted interaction rules, labeled demonstrations, or robot-specific control policies, limiting their scalability and transferability in construction environments. We propose a real-time, LiDAR-only framework that learns interaction-aware path corrections from unlabeled demonstrations. Constant-velocity extrapolation generates residual learning targets, while a GNN models relationships among the robot, pedestrians, and goal context. During deployment, an extended Kalman filter tracks LiDAR detections to construct dynamic graphs, and the GNN offsets planner-generated waypoints through a planner-agnostic interface. Within the bricklaying trial, the GNN reduced path irregularity by 39.2\% and increased minimum TTC. Across Dynablox sequences, it increased minimum TTC by 38.3\% while producing shorter, smoother paths than the baselines. Ablation studies supported a 1.0-s prediction interval and confirmed the benefits of target context, reflection augmentation, and feature normalization.
tldr: This paper proposes a LiDAR-only GNN framework that learns interaction-aware path corrections from unlabeled demonstrations for construction robots, using constant-velocity extrapolation for residual targets and an EKF-based graph construction, achieving safer and smoother navigation in simulation and real-world trials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅依赖LiDAR的GNN框架，利用无标注示范学习建筑机器人的交互感知路径修正，通过恒速外推生成残差目标并构建动态图，在仿真和真实试验中实现了更安全、更平滑的导航。
summary_zh: 建筑工人在附近作业时，施工机器人所需的导航系统既要能够预测人类运动，又要对动态且非结构化的现场条件保持鲁棒性。然而，现有的社交导航方法依赖手工设计的交互规则、标注示范或特定于机器人的控制策略，限制了其在施工环境中的可扩展性和可迁移性。我们提出了一种仅基于激光雷达的实时框架，该框架能够从无标注示范中学习交互感知的路径修正。通过恒定速度外推生成残差学习目标，同时使用图神经网络（GNN）建模机器人、行人和目标上下文之间的关系。在部署阶段，扩展卡尔曼滤波器跟踪激光雷达检测结果以构建动态图，GNN则通过与规划器无关的接口对规划器生成的路径点进行偏移修正。在砌砖试验中，GNN将路径不规则度降低了39.2%，并提高了最小TTC（碰撞时间）。在Dynablox序列中，GNN将最小TTC提升了38.3%，同时相比基线方法生成了更短、更平滑的路径。消融研究支持1.0秒的预测区间，并证实了目标上下文、反射增强和特征归一化的有效性。

title: Behavior Spatial Benchmark: Evaluating Spatial Understanding for Robotics
summary: Robot tasks require grounding spatial language in physical scenes, but task success alone cannot establish whether spatial instructions are followed. We present BEHAVIOR-Spatial, a benchmark built on BEHAVIOR-1K that measures spatial question answering, point-based target grounding, and robot action to examine how VLM spatial understanding relates to VLA behavior. It comprises 3,256 spatial questions across 49 activities, 1,240 grounding queries across 14 manipulation tasks, and action evaluations covering those 14 tasks and 10 navigation tasks. Our manipulation protocol evaluates held-out configurations and instruction following when the requested target changes within a fixed training layout. The baseline achieves 41.6% on held-out configurations but only 16.1% under changed instructions. VLM adaptation and robot-data pretraining provide limited improvements, whereas oracle visual target cues raise these rates to 60.3% and 38.0%, respectively. Perception evaluations reveal policy-dependent correlations between VLM question-answering and grounding accuracy and VLA manipulation performance. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial instruction following alongside task completion and examining when spatial perception performance translates into robot behavior. Project website: https://arielchen07.github.io/behavior-spatial/.
tldr: This paper introduces BEHAVIOR-Spatial, a benchmark for evaluating spatial understanding in robotics through spatial QA, point-based grounding, and robot action, revealing that VLM spatial understanding only partially translates to VLA manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BEHAVIOR-Spatial，一个通过空间问答、点定位和机器人动作来评估空间理解的基准，揭示了VLM空间理解仅部分转化为VLA操作性能。
summary_zh: 机器人任务要求将空间语言具体落实到物理场景中，但仅凭任务成功本身无法确认空间指令是否得到遵循。我们提出了BEHAVIOR-Spatial，一个基于BEHAVIOR-1K构建的基准测试，用于衡量空间问答、基于点的目标定位以及机器人动作，从而考察VLM空间理解与VLA行为之间的关系。该基准包含49项活动中的3，256个空间问题、14项操作任务中的1，240个定位查询，以及覆盖上述14项任务和10项导航任务的动作评估。我们的操作协议评估了在固定训练布局内、当请求目标发生变化时的未见配置和指令遵循情况。基线模型在未见配置上达到41.6%的准确率，但在指令变化场景下仅达到16.1%。VLM适配和机器人数据预训练带来的改进有限，而使用视觉目标线索作为参考则分别将这两项指标提升至60.3%和38.0%。感知评估揭示了VLM问答和定位准确性与VLA操作表现之间存在策略相关的关联性。综合来看，这些发现促使我们在评估任务完成的同时，也需评估空间指令遵循情况，并进一步考察空间感知表现何时能够转化为机器人行为。项目网站：https://arielchen07.github.io/behavior-spatial/。

title: ElevateHead: Decide Once, Then Commit: When the Action Head Matters for Multimodal Imitation
summary: Robots that learn from people often see several valid ways to do the same task: pass an obstacle on the left or on the right, open the microwave or move the kettle first. A policy that re-decides at every step can waver between these ways mid-task. We ask when the action head (the part of a policy that turns the state into actions) matters, and how it should make this choice. On a controlled task, heads that sample one way succeed far more often than a head that averages the ways when the demonstrations contain several ways and the state gives no hint which to take (+0.72 success with two ways); this trend was not reproduced on the other tasks we ran. We then present ElevateHead, a head that decides once at a learned decision point, commits to that choice for the episode, and exposes the choice as an input a user can set. We designed it by diagnosis: each version was frozen and tested on tasks it had not seen, and the next version changed only what a measured failure pointed to; predictions were registered before each run. The first four versions each fell below BeT on at least one held-out task. The fifth completed all four subtasks of the held-out Franka Kitchen task in 45.2% of episodes against 29.3% for BeT, the strongest baseline across our tasks (+0.160, 95% CI [+0.129, +0.188]); when a mode was forced, the first completed subtask matched it in 95% of successful episodes. Diagnosis also located where commitment breaks: varied start positions (repaired on the controlled task: commitment 0.22 to 0.81, success 0.74 to 0.91) and varied object placement (partly repaired: in an exploratory variant, commitment 0.03 to 0.59 on aligning with no detectable change in success). On held-out block stacking, version 4 was comparable to BeT and did not exceed it. A real-robot test with predictions fixed in advance is planned for a follow-up version of this paper.
tldr: This paper investigates when the action head in imitation learning policies matters for multimodal tasks and proposes ElevateHead, a head that commits to a decision at a learned point, improving success on Franka Kitchen and a controlled task.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了模仿学习策略中动作头在多模态任务中的重要性，并提出了 ElevateHead，一种在习得决策点做出承诺的动作头，在 Franka Kitchen 和受控任务上提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 从人类那里学习的机器人常常会看到完成同一任务的多种有效方式：从左侧或右侧绕过障碍物，先打开微波炉还是先移动水壶。一种在每一步都重新决策的策略可能在任务中途在这些方式之间摇摆不定。我们探究行动头（策略中将状态转化为行动的部分）何时起作用，以及它应如何做出这一选择。在一个受控任务中，当演示包含多种方式且状态未给出任何线索表明该选哪种时，对单种方式进行采样的行动头比将各种方式平均化的行动头成功率高得多（两种方式时成功率+0.72）；这一趋势在我们运行的其他任务中未被复现。随后我们提出了ElevateHead，这是一种在学到的决策点一次性做出决定、在整幕中坚持该选择、并将该选择作为用户可设置的输入暴露出来的行动头。我们通过诊断来设计它：每个版本都被冻结并在其未见过的任务上进行测试，下一版本仅针对测量失败所指出的问题做出修改；每次运行前都预先登记预测。前四个版本在至少一个保留任务上均低于BeT。第五个版本在保留的Franka Kitchen任务中，45.2%的幕中完成了全部四个子任务，而BeT为29.3%，这是我们所有任务中最强的基线（+0.160，95%置信区间[+0.129，+0.188]）；当强制指定一种模式时，首个完成的子任务在95%的成功幕中与指定模式一致。诊断还定位了承诺在何处失效：起始位置变化（在受控任务上已修复：承诺从0.22提升至0.81，成功率从0.74提升至0.91）和物体位置变化（部分修复：在一个探索性变体中，对齐的承诺从0.03提升至0.59，而成功率无可检测变化）。在保留的叠积木任务中，版本4与BeT相当，且未超过它。带有预先固定预测的真实机器人测试计划在本论文的后续版本中进行。

title: Learning Functional Specialisation for Bimanual Robotic Control
summary: Bimanual robotic control requires simultaneous management of distinct functional demands under motor noise, energetic costs, and communication delays. We investigate how learning responsibility should be organised across modular controllers and the two arms in a simulated musculoskeletal system with two communicating recurrent controllers. Using a 2 x 2 design, we compare differential versus shared controller objectives and fixed versus balanced hand-task assignments. Task-aligned functional specialisation was strongest when differential objectives were combined with a fixed assignment aligned with contralateral control routing. This condition achieved the highest canonical-task performance and control efficiency, reaching 81.33% bimanual success. Its advantage over shared objectives increased with motor noise but narrowed under stronger energy penalties. Stronger specialisation also reduced hand-role flexibility: reversing the hand roles decreased bimanual success by 80.46 percentage points under Differential-Fixed training, compared with 1.51 percentage points under Shared-Balanced training. These results show that controller objectives and hand-task experience jointly determine functional organisation. Stronger role-specific specialisation favours performance and efficiency when roles remain stable, whereas more distributed training favours interchangeability when roles change.
tldr: This paper studies how differential objectives and fixed hand-task assignments induce functional specialisation in bimanual robotic control, achieving high performance and efficiency at the cost of flexibility under role reversal.
tldr_zh: 本文研究差异目标和固定手部任务分配如何引起双臂机器人控制的功能特化，在角色稳定时实现高表现和高效率，但在角色互换时灵活性下降。
summary_zh: 双手机器人控制要求在运动噪声、能量消耗和通信延迟的条件下，同时管理多种不同的功能需求。我们研究在包含两个通信递归控制器的模拟肌肉骨骼系统中，学习责任应如何在模块化控制器和双臂之间进行组织。通过2×2实验设计，我们比较了差异化与共享控制器目标，以及固定与平衡的手-任务分配。当差异化目标与对侧控制路由一致的固定分配相结合时，任务对齐的功能特化最为显著。该条件实现了最高的典型任务表现和控制效率，双手成功率达到81.33%。其相对于共享目标的优势随运动噪声增加而增大，但在更强的能量惩罚下缩小。更强的特化还降低了手部角色的灵活性：在差异化-固定训练下，反转手部角色使双手成功率下降80.46个百分点，而在共享-平衡训练下仅下降1.51个百分点。这些结果表明，控制器目标和手-任务经验共同决定功能组织。当角色保持稳定时，更强的角色特化有利于表现和效率；而当角色发生变化时，更分布的训练则有利于可互换性。

title: LegoOcc++: Towards Consistent Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction is important for embodied agents operating in complex environments whose semantic categories extend beyond fixed taxonomies. While recent studies have explored open-vocabulary occupancy in outdoor driving scenarios, indoor environments remain challenging due to dense occlusions, complex geometry, and fine-grained long-tailed semantics. To reduce the need for expensive voxel-level semantic annotations, we study a geometry-only supervision setting requiring only binary occupancy labels. We build upon Language-Embedded Gaussians as a unified representation coupling 3D geometry with language-aligned semantics. For geometry learning, we introduce an opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy formulation that enables stable volumetric aggregation under binary occupancy supervision. For semantic learning, we render Gaussian features into images and align them with a frozen open-vocabulary model, together with Progressive Temperature Decay to reduce feature mixing during Gaussian splatting. Building on this framework, we further introduce Instance-Level Semantic Consistency to alleviate fragmented object predictions, and Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection to provide informative and less redundant multi-view semantic supervision. We also extend our framework to outdoor driving scenarios to evaluate its generality across substantially different environments. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves strong open-vocabulary occupancy performance, validating the effectiveness and generality of our framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc.
tldr: LegoOcc++ proposes a geometry-only supervised open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction method using Language-Embedded Gaussians, with opacity-aware Poisson aggregation, progressive temperature decay, instance-level semantic consistency, and covisibility-aware support-view selection, demonstrating strong performance in both indoor and outdoor driving scenarios.
tldr_zh: LegoOcc++提出了一种仅需几何监督的开放词汇3D占用预测方法，利用语言嵌入高斯表示，结合透明度感知的泊松聚合、渐进温度衰减、实例级语义一致性和共视感知支持视图选择，在室内和室外驾驶场景中均表现出色。
summary_zh: 开放词汇三维占用预测对于在复杂环境中运行的具身智能体非常重要，因为这些环境中的语义类别超出了固定的分类体系。尽管已有研究探索了户外驾驶场景中的开放词汇占用预测，但室内环境由于密集遮挡、复杂几何结构以及细粒度的长尾语义仍然具有挑战性。为降低对昂贵的体素级语义标注的需求，我们研究了一种仅需二值占用标签的几何监督设置。我们基于语言嵌入高斯分布作为统一表示，将三维几何与语言对齐的语义耦合起来。在几何学习方面，我们引入了一种透明度感知的基于泊松的高斯到占用公式，使得在二值占用监督下能够进行稳定的体素聚合。在语义学习方面，我们将高斯特征渲染为图像，并将其与冻结的开放词汇模型对齐，同时采用渐进式温度衰减来减少高斯溅射过程中的特征混合。在此框架基础上，我们进一步引入实例级语义一致性以缓解碎片化的对象预测问题，以及共视感知的支持视图选择方法，以提供信息丰富且冗余度较低的多视图语义监督。我们还将框架扩展到户外驾驶场景，以评估其在显著不同环境中的泛化能力。在室内和室外基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法取得了优异的开放词汇占用性能，验证了框架的有效性和泛化能力。代码将在 https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc 提供。

title: Explaining Navigation Decisions: Stage-Aware Visual Attribution for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly enable robots to follow language instructions, understanding their navigation decisions becomes important for reliable deployment. Existing explainability methods overlook a key challenge in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN): evidence for the current action may be distributed across historical and current observations and associated with different instruction stages. We identify instruction-stage insensitivity, where existing methods produce similar explanations despite changes across different navigation stages. To address this issue, we propose a stage-aware attribution framework for VLN. We first construct action-conditioned temporal instruction--visual attributions across observations. These attributions are projected into instruction space to estimate stage associations, which guide the aggregation of relevant historical evidence for refining the current explanation. An instruction-guided spatial filter further suppresses isolated responses while preserving compact, instruction-relevant regions. Experiments across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks show improved attribution quality over existing methods. We further demonstrate that our method acts as a diagnostic tool for analyzing failure cases, and validate its applicability to real-world navigation on a Unitree G1 robot.
tldr: This paper presents a stage-aware attribution framework for Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) that improves explainability by generating action-conditioned temporal instruction-visual attributions, projecting them into instruction space to estimate stage associations, and using an instruction-guided spatial filter to refine explanations. Experiments show improved attribution quality across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks, and validation on a Unitree G1 robot demonstrates real-world applicability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对视觉语言导航(VLN)的阶段感知归因框架，通过生成动作条件下的时间指令-视觉归因，将其投影到指令空间以估计阶段关联，并使用指令引导的空间滤波器来细化解释。实验在多个VLN策略和基准上展示了改进的归因质量，并在Unitree G1机器人上验证了其实际应用。
summary_zh: 随着视觉-语言模型（VLMs）日益赋能机器人遵循语言指令，理解其导航决策对于可靠部署变得至关重要。现有的可解释性方法忽视了一个视觉-语言导航（VLN）中的关键挑战：当前动作的证据可能分布在历史和当前的观测中，并与不同的指令阶段相关联。我们识别出指令阶段不敏感性问题，即现有方法在不同导航阶段变化时仍产生相似的解释。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种面向阶段的VLN归因框架。我们首先构建基于动作条件的跨观测时间指令-视觉归因。这些归因被投影到指令空间中以估计阶段关联，进而指导相关历史证据的聚合，以精化当前解释。指令引导的空间滤波器进一步抑制孤立响应，同时保留紧凑且与指令相关的区域。在多个VLN策略和基准上的实验表明，相较于现有方法，归因质量有所提升。我们进一步证明，我们的方法可作为诊断工具用于分析失败案例，并验证其在Unitree G1机器人真实世界导航中的适用性。

title: Nonlinear Control of Aerial Manipulator
summary: This paper presents two controllers for a quadrotor equipped with a two-DOF robot manipulator that physically interacts with the environment. Cartesian impedance and adaptive sliding mode controllers are implemented and compared for a simple hovering task in the presence of some bounded disturbance. A full dynamic model is developed, and the two above controllers are implemented with the same initial conditions and desired position.
tldr: This paper presents and compares two nonlinear controllers (Cartesian impedance and adaptive sliding mode) for a quadrotor with a two-DOF manipulator interacting with the environment during a hovering task under bounded disturbances.
tldr_zh: 本文针对带有两自由度机械臂的四旋翼飞行器，提出并比较了笛卡尔阻抗和自适应滑模两种非线性控制器，用于存在有界扰动下的悬停任务。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对配备两自由度机器人机械臂并与环境发生物理交互的四旋翼飞行器的两种控制器。实现了笛卡尔阻抗控制器与自适应滑模控制器，并在存在有界干扰的情况下，针对简单的悬停任务进行了比较。建立了完整的动力学模型，并在相同的初始条件和期望位置下实现了上述两种控制器。

title: Doppler-aided Position-Velocity Tracking of Hidden Objects using mmWave Radar
summary: Safe indoor operation requires autonomous tracking of objects that are not directly visible to the robot. Optical non-line-of-sight (NLoS) methods depend on ambient lighting and scene geometry or on weak multi-bounce returns that need long acquisitions. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar offers an attractive alternative: walls act as reflectors for mmWave signals, and frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radars enable fast, practical measurement of range, angle, and velocity. However, the low resolution of these radars leads to spatially ambiguous observations. The Doppler information, although particularly sensitive to target motion, remains underexplored in indoor NLoS localization: existing methods emphasize spatial representations and either collapse or discard the Doppler dimension before learning. To leverage the complete Range-Azimuth-Doppler (RAD) information, we acquire the first indoor NLoS radar dataset that pairs sequential RAD measurements with synchronized position and velocity ground truth under controlled variations in motion: 576 sequences totaling 720,856 frames across 12 trajectories of a mobile robot moving along varying speeds, starting positions, and material configurations. We then formulate NLoS tracking as sequential position-velocity estimation rather than frame-wise localization: a shared 3-D encoder processes the full RAD representation of consecutive frames, separate recurrent branches estimate position and velocity, and post-inference refinement combines the two into a motion-consistent trajectory. Our method achieves 8.95cm position and 1.75cm/s velocity errors on held-out trajectories and generalizes to unseen scenarios involving a moving human target. Together, our dataset and tracker establish a benchmark for tracking hidden moving targets with a low-cost radar.
tldr: This paper introduces the first indoor non-line-of-sight (NLoS) radar dataset with synchronized position-velocity ground truth and a recurrent 3D encoder-based tracker that leverages full Range-Azimuth-Doppler (RAD) information to accurately track hidden moving targets, achieving low errors on held-out trajectories and generalizing to unseen human targets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个带同步位置-速度真值的室内非视距雷达数据集，并设计了一种利用完整距离-方位-多普勒（RAD）信息的循环三维编码器跟踪器，以高精度跟踪隐藏移动目标，并在未见轨迹和未知行人目标上展现泛化能力。
summary_zh: 安全室内操作要求机器人能够自主追踪其视线之外的目标。光学非视距（NLoS）方法依赖于环境光照和场景几何结构，或依赖于需要长时间采集的微弱多次反射信号。毫米波（mmWave）雷达提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案：墙壁可作为毫米波信号的反射体，且调频连续波（FMCW）雷达能够快速、实用地测量距离、角度和速度。然而，这类雷达的低分辨率会导致空间观测存在模糊性。多普勒信息虽然对目标运动尤为敏感，但在室内非视距定位中仍未得到充分探索：现有方法侧重于空间表示，并在学习之前对多普勒维度进行压缩或直接丢弃。为了充分利用完整的距离-方位-多普勒（RAD）信息，我们采集了首个室内非视距雷达数据集，该数据集将顺序RAD测量与同步的位置和速度真实值配对，并在受控的运动变化条件下采集：共576个序列，总计720,856帧，涵盖12条移动机器人轨迹，其速度、起始位置和材料配置各不相同。随后，我们将非视距跟踪表述为顺序位置-速度估计，而非逐帧定位：共享的3D编码器处理连续帧的完整RAD表示，分离的循环分支分别估计位置和速度，推理后的优化阶段将两者融合为运动一致的轨迹。我们的方法在留出轨迹上实现了8.95厘米的位置误差和1.75厘米/秒的速度误差，并能泛化到涉及移动人体目标的未见场景中。综合而言，我们的数据集和跟踪器为使用低成本雷达跟踪隐藏移动目标建立了基准。

title: Lightweight Change Detection for Adaptive Collective Perception in Dynamic Environments
summary: Swarm robotics enables scalable inspection through collective perception, where robots infer environmental properties from distributed observations. A common benchmark considers robots exploring black-white tiled environments and determining the majority tile type. While most work studies static environments, dynamic environments remain underexplored. We study collective perception in dynamic environments where the tile proportion and the spatial correlation of surface patterns may change over time. To enable implementation on resource-constrained robots, we integrate a lightweight change detection mechanism into a Bayesian collective decision-making framework that resets robot beliefs when distribution shifts are detected. The proposed detector requires constant memory and constant per-sample computation, unlike two recent competitive approaches that store the full sample stream, making it suitable for memory-constrained robots. We further introduce a method that detects spatially correlated sampling and adapts sampling intervals online to mitigate correlation effects. Our simulation results in Webots show competitive change detection delays, more consistent precision across communication settings, and improved decision accuracy under changing spatial correlations.
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight change detection mechanism for Bayesian collective perception in swarm robotics, enabling adaptive decision-making in dynamic environments with constant memory and computation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级变化检测机制，用于群体机器人中的贝叶斯集体感知，在动态环境中实现自适应决策，且内存和计算开销恒定。
summary_zh: 集群机器人通过集体感知实现可扩展的检测，其中机器人从分布式观测中推断环境属性。一个常见的基准测试是让机器人探索黑白瓷砖环境并确定占多数的瓷砖类型。尽管大多数研究关注静态环境，动态环境仍未得到充分探索。我们研究了动态环境中的集体感知问题，其中瓷砖比例及表面图案的空间相关性可能随时间变化。为了在资源受限的机器人上实现，我们将一种轻量级变化检测机制集成到贝叶斯集体决策框架中，当检测到分布变化时重置机器人信念。与两种近期需要存储完整样本流的竞争方法不同，所提出的检测器要求恒定内存和恒定每样本计算量，因此适用于内存受限的机器人。我们进一步引入了一种方法，用于检测空间相关性采样并在线调整采样间隔以减轻相关效应。我们在Webots中的仿真结果表明，该方法在变化检测延迟方面具有竞争力，在不同通信设置下精度更为一致，并且在空间相关性变化时决策准确性有所提升。

title: Extended LASMP: Language Aided Subset Sampling Based Motion Planner for Drone Navigation
summary: This paper proposes a command-aligned sampling distribution that incorporates navigation commands directly into the exploration process to improve the efficiency of sampling-based motion planning for quadcopters in three-dimensional environments. Inspired by the Language-Aided Subset Sampling Motion Planner, this paper extends command-aware subset sampling to aerial systems. Subset sampling is generalized to command-aligned regions, enabling structured 3D exploration while preserving probabilistic completeness. Natural language instructions are grounded into yaw-conditioned and altitude-aware geometric constraints using a prompt-based large language model for entity extraction and instruction validation. Extensive simulations in complex environments demonstrate that the proposed method generates collision-free, consistent trajectories while significantly reducing sampling effort compared to uniform RRT-based planners.
tldr: This paper extends a language-aided sampling-based motion planner to drone navigation, using LLM-grounded natural language commands to guide 3D exploration for more efficient collision-free trajectory generation.
tldr_zh: 本文将语言辅助的基于采样的运动规划器扩展到无人机导航，利用LLM将自然语言指令转化为几何约束，引导三维空间探索，从而更高效地生成无碰撞轨迹。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种命令对齐的采样分布方法，将导航指令直接融入探索过程，以提高三维环境下四旋翼无人机基于采样的运动规划效率。受语言辅助子集采样运动规划器的启发，本文将命令感知的子集采样扩展至空中系统。子集采样被推广至命令对齐区域，从而在保持概率完备性的同时，实现结构化的三维探索。通过基于提示的大语言模型进行实体提取与指令验证，将自然语言指令落地为偏航条件和高度感知的几何约束。在复杂环境中进行的大量仿真表明，与基于均匀RRT的规划器相比，所提方法能够在显著减少采样工作量的同时，生成无碰撞且一致的轨迹。

title: T-ConSG: A LiDAR-Based Real-Time Temporal Construction Scene Graph for Dynamic and Evolving Environments
summary: Dynamic and continuously evolving environments present significant challenges for robotic mapping and scene understanding, particularly on construction sites where moving agents, temporary obstacles, and persistent structural changes coexist. While dynamic and long-term SLAM methods can detect motion and environmental changes, their outputs are predominantly metric representations that provide limited structure for higher-level spatial and temporal reasoning. This paper presents a LiDAR-based real-time temporal construction scene graph (T-ConSG) that jointly represents free-space regions, static objects, dynamic objects, and environmental events with spatial-relational and event-participation edges. The proposed framework incrementally constructs the graph from LiDAR-derived geometric evidence, maintaining persistent free-space and static-object information while tracking dynamic objects. Changes in accumulated spatial evidence are further represented as explicit installation and removal events, allowing the graph to capture both transient dynamics and persistent environmental evolution. We demonstrate the proposed representation through three complementary application studies: dynamics-aware navigation in a bricklaying testbed, construction progress monitoring on the ConSLAM dataset, and online change detection in a simulated construction environment. The results demonstrate that the proposed T-ConSG provides a unified representation for organizing spatial and temporal information and supports robotic reasoning across environments containing both short-term dynamics and persistent changes.
tldr: This paper introduces T-ConSG, a LiDAR-based real-time scene graph for dynamic construction environments, representing free space, static/dynamic objects, and environmental events to support navigation, progress monitoring, and change detection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出T-ConSG，一种基于激光雷达的实时场景图，用于动态建筑环境，表示自由空间、静态/动态物体和环境事件，以支持导航、进度监测和变化检测。
summary_zh: 动态且持续变化的环境为机器人建图和场景理解带来了重大挑战，尤其是在建筑工地，移动主体、临时障碍物和持续的结构变化并存。尽管动态和长期SLAM方法能够检测运动和環境变化，但其输出主要以度量表示为主，为更高层次的时空推理提供的结构有限。本文提出了一种基于LiDAR的实时时间建筑场景图（T-ConSG），该图通过空间关系和事件参与边联合表示自由空间区域、静态物体、动态物体和环境事件。所提出的框架从LiDAR衍生的几何证据中增量构建图结构，在跟踪动态物体的同时维护持续的自由空间和静态物体信息。累积的空间证据变化进一步被表示为明确的安装和移除事件，使图能够同时捕捉瞬态动态和持续的环境演化。我们通过三个互补的应用研究验证了所提出的表示方法：砖砌试验平台中的动态感知导航、ConSLAM数据集上的施工进度监测，以及模拟建筑环境中的在线变化检测。结果表明，所提出的T-ConSG为组织空间和时间信息提供了统一的表示，并支持机器人对包含短期动态和持续变化的环境进行推理。

title: Cut a Wall, See a Wall: Identity Substitution in Occluded Point-Cloud Perception for Construction Robots
summary: Construction robots must label building elements they can only partly see. We show that when occlusion at test time removes whole regions of a scene, rather than parts of an object as in training, point-cloud segmentation networks do not simply miss the hidden elements: they relabel them, and the errors collapse onto a single sink class. With fixed synthetic layouts the column absorbs up to 70% of all test points; with randomized layouts the sink moves to the stair, predicted at 4.5-5.4x its true share across three training seeds. Baseline mIoU falls to 0.15-0.27 (fixed) and 0.36-0.72 (randomized), and up to 269 whole objects vanish in a single test set. Appending 14 hand-computed geometric features per point (GPE) restores mIoU to 0.54-0.92 and removes 64-100% of whole-object losses in every run, for PointNet++ and a PTv3-style transformer in both layout regimes; on real S3DIS scans it removes every whole-wall loss (10 to 0). In an as-built column check computed from the predictions, GPE raises the share of correctly checked views from 17-58% to 71-92%. Feature permutation on fixed, randomized and real scenes explains the pattern: each class relies on whichever cue is stable in its training data, position for height-banded slabs and beams, intrinsic shape for walls and stairs once their position varies. Occlusion augmentation is a strong alternative on mIoU, but in every setting it loses more whole objects than GPE (e.g., 25-35 vs. 0).
tldr: This paper investigates and mitigates severe semantic mislabeling in point-cloud segmentation for construction robots under whole-region occlusion, showing that appending hand-computed geometric features (GPE) significantly restores accuracy and prevents whole-object losses.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了施工机器人在整体遮挡下点云分割中的严重语义误标问题，并展示附加手算几何特征(GPE)能显著恢复精度并防止整体物体丢失。
summary_zh: 施工机器人在对建筑元素进行标注时，往往只能看到这些元素的部分区域。本研究表明，当测试时的遮挡移除的是场景中的整片区域，而非训练中物体的一部分时，点云分割网络并非仅仅遗漏被遮挡的元素，而是会对它们进行错误标注，且误差集中汇入单一“汇类”。在固定合成布局下，该类别吸收了高达70%的测试点；在随机化布局下，汇类转移至楼梯，其预测占比高达真实占比的4.5至5.4倍（跨三个训练种子）。基线mIoU降至0.15-0.27（固定布局）及0.36-0.72（随机化布局），单个测试集中最多有269个完整物体消失。为每个点附加14个手工计算的几何特征（GPE）后，mIoU恢复至0.54-0.92，且在每次运行中消除了64-100%的完整物体丢失，这一结果在PointNet++和PTv3风格变换器及两种布局模式下均成立；在真实S3DIS扫描数据上，该方法将完整墙体丢失次数从10降至0。在基于预测结果进行的竣工柱体检查中，GPE将正确检查视图的比例从17-58%提升至71-92%。对固定、随机化及真实场景进行的特征置换实验揭示了该现象的成因：每个类别依赖其训练数据中稳定的线索——高度分层的板与梁依赖位置信息，而墙体与楼梯在位置变化时则依赖固有形状。遮挡增强在mIoU指标上是强有力的替代方案，但在所有设置中其完整物体丢失数量均高于GPE（例如，25-35对比0）。

title: Enabling Motion-Induced WiFi-CSI Sensing in Multi-Robot Systems: A Simulation Framework
summary: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) enables fine-grained sensing of spatial relationships between wireless devices. The WiFi Sensor for Robotics (WSR) toolbox demonstrated that WiFi-CSI measurements collected during robot motion, combined with odometry, can be used to synthesize virtual antenna arrays, enabling motion-induced bearing estimation in multi-robot experiments. However, deploying the WSR approach has remained challenging due to its limited integration with standard robotics tools and reliance on deprecated WiFi-CSI acquisition hardware. This work presents an open-source simulation framework that integrates the WSR sensing pipeline within the robotic simulator Gazebo. The framework generates synthetic WiFi-CSI measurements with realistic physical signal properties and leverages realistic robot motion required for motion-induced sensing and downstream localization. It further supports processing both simulated and real WiFi-CSI data for direct comparison and validation. Our aim is to make WSR-style sensing accessible as a modular sensing modality for robotic research. We validate our framework by comparing simulated and real-world experiments using TurtleBot3 robots, and demonstrate its use for bearing estimation and robot localization. This work lowers the barrier to entry for WiFi-CSI-based sensing in multi-robot systems and provides a foundation for integrating WiFi-CSI sensing with multi-modal perception for localization and coordination. All code and experimental details are publicly available at https://github.com/baharhaghighat/DARS_2026_Dijkstra_et_al
tldr: This paper presents an open-source simulation framework integrating WiFi-CSI sensing into Gazebo for multi-robot systems, enabling motion-induced bearing estimation and localization, validated with TurtleBot3 robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个将WiFi-CSI传感集成到Gazebo中的开源仿真框架，用于多机器人系统的运动诱发测向和定位，并通过TurtleBot3机器人进行了验证。
summary_zh: WiFi信道状态信息（CSI）能够实现对无线设备之间空间关系的细粒度感知。WiFi机器人传感器（WSR）工具箱证明，在机器人运动过程中采集的WiFi-CSI测量值，结合里程计数据，可用于合成虚拟天线阵列，从而在多机器人实验中实现基于运动的到达角估计。然而，由于WSR方法与标准机器人工具的集成有限，且依赖已淘汰的WiFi-CSI采集硬件，其部署仍面临挑战。本工作提出一种开源仿真框架，将WSR感知流程集成到机器人仿真器Gazebo中。该框架生成具有真实物理信号特性的合成WiFi-CSI测量值，并利用运动诱导感知及下游定位所需的真实机器人运动。它还支持对仿真和真实WiFi-CSI数据的处理，以便直接进行比较和验证。我们的目标是使WSR风格的感知能够作为机器人研究中的模块化感知模态被广泛使用。我们通过使用TurtleBot3机器人对比仿真与真实实验来验证框架，并展示其在到达角估计和机器人定位中的应用。本工作降低了多机器人系统中基于WiFi-CSI感知的入门门槛，并为将WiFi-CSI感知与多模态感知相结合以实现定位与协同提供了基础。所有代码和实验细节公开可查：https://github.com/baharhaghighat/DARS_2026_Dijkstra_et_al

title: Real-Time Human Trajectory Prediction from RGB-D for Mobile Robots Using Bi-Mamba
summary: Predicting the short-term future trajectory of a person from RGB-D cameras is a key capability for mobile robots navigating in dynamic and human populated environment. The key challenge to deploying learned predictors on real robots is the train-deploy pipeline gap. Training data are often prepared with an idealized, smoothed ground truth, whereas at inference, the model is fed noisy estimates from pose detectors and depth sensors. The model is therefore evaluated on an input distribution it never encountered during training. Most existing models rely on recurrent neural networks (RNNs) or transformers, which either struggle to capture short-term temporal dependencies or suffer from computational cost. We present TrajMamba, a lightweight, bidirectional state space model for short-term human trajectory prediction using an RGB-D camera. The model uses a single shared processing path for both training and deployment, aligning human pose extraction, depth back projection, and smoothing processes. It encodes a short window of persons's hip center velocities with stacked bidirectional Mamba blocks and decodes future velocities with a GRU head. On the ETH/UCY benchmark, TrajMamba reaches an average ADE of 0.29 m FDE of 0.51 m.
